QuestInfo.name: [Eluna Express] Sweat and Tears
QuestInfo.0: Spend some more time investigating Lidium in Ariant, then speak with Muhammad.
QuestInfo.1: Muhammad is incensed about young people nowadays having no idea of Lidium's value. It's as easy to get as walking down to the Auction House and buying it. It used to be that ore was wrested from the ground by hand, and you broke a real sweat and earned it... You politely interrupt his diatribe against the youth of the day to ask if he has any Lidium, and as it turns out, he will gladly provide you with some if you do an honest day's work for it. Hunt 1,500 Desert Rabbits around town.
QuestInfo.2: You hunted the Desert Rabbits around town. Now you can get the Lidium from Muhammad.
